scientific_integrity: Exact labelled palette and adjacency definitions; full-source breadth-first search and orbit-reduced independent reconstruction agree; existing chromatic counts and general connectivity bounds are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite, exhaustively checked ten-vertex graph result. Historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed earlier enumerations; the cited month-level 2007 report date was not sharpened to an unsupported day. No inference to arbitrary cubic or Kneser graphs is claimed. The two standalone programs provide independently structured computational checks, not a separate human or institutional validation.
title: Exact Petersen vertex-recolouring geometry at three and four colours
